messages:
Sam (partnerships): quick kickoff — we need a focused runbook for the cloud marketplace listing (AWS/GCP/Azure) for the EMEA trial pack. main asks: IAM roles/assume policy, AMI/container images, pricing sku mapping, legal attestation, and a short preview doc for partners.
Maria (legal): noted. i'll need the proposed terms + trial duration and data-processing notes. CC me on any customer-facing trial text.
Ajay (product): trial tier = 14 days, limited to 10 seats. pricing sku: we want per-seat monthly + metered compute. will sketch mapping later today.
Ben (eng): is there a minimum image set we should provide? we can supply AMIs for aws, gcp images, and a container image for azure marketplace. need size/perf matrix.
Julian (cloud-ops): for AWS AMI we need account IDs + signing key to share AMIs across publisher accounts. for GCP we need project + service account to grant compute.imageUser role. for Azure, publisher needs SAS to upload VHD or container registry access.
Paul (partner-success): partner wants a simple trial onboarding flow. ask: can we provide a pre-provisioned sandbox for demos? that would speed adoption.
Sam (partnerships): good point. paul — can we support a short-lived demo tenant? maybe via dedicated sandbox project with quotas.
Paul (partner-success): yes, we can. i'd request 2 sandbox tenants initially.
Priya (security): we'll need an attestation doc for data residency and logging. also require that AMIs/images are scanned and SBOM attached.
Maria (legal): include a checkbox: "no customer data retained beyond trial unless they opt-in" in the trial T&Cs. send me the draft.
Ben (eng): dev note — AMI pipeline: build -> scan -> sign -> publish. code snippet for assume role policy we expect partners to provide:
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::XXXXXXXXXXXX:role/MarketplacePublishRole"},
      "Action": "sts:AssumeRole"
    }
  ]
}
```
Ben (eng): for GCP: we need a service account with roles/compute.imageUser and roles/storage.objectViewer on the image bucket.
Julian (cloud-ops): i'll prep a checklist for each cloud and the exact account/role names we need. publishing windows: aws/gcp ~ 24-48h after artifacts + legal sign-off. azure sometimes longer.
DevOps-Bot: staging-creds created for publisher-sandbox (expires 2024-07-10). link: https://internal-ci.example.com/creds/abcd1234 (expires in 7 days)
Sam (partnerships): thanks bot. next steps: 1) ben + julian produce AMI/container publish checklist by EOD tomorrow, 2) ajay + maria draft trial T&Cs + pricing mapping, 3) paul to confirm sandbox tenants and partner comms.
Ajay (product): i'll own the pricing spreadsheet. will drop in google drive and ping here.
Maria (legal): i'll get a short attestation template and the opt-out clause. target: legal sign-off in 3 business days.
Ben (eng): will add SBOM step and scanner output example to the checklist. also can provide a small perf doc (2 configs) for partner listing page.
Priya (security): i'll sign off on scanning + recommended hardening baseline (CIS-lite) once checklist is up.
Julian (cloud-ops): ETA for checklist: 24 hours. will include commands and iam snippets.
Paul (partner-success): i'll draft a partner-facing blurb and a short onboarding flow doc for their marketplace listing page.
Sam (partnerships): awesome. tagging followups: @Maria (legal) @Ben (eng) @Julian (cloud-ops) @Priya (security) — please add blockers here.
Ben (eng): only blocker is access to partner build artifacts. paul, can you get that SAS/url?
Paul (partner-success): pinged partner, they said they'll upload to our staging bucket by EOD.
Ajay (product): also let's add a short QA prompt set we can use to smoke test the marketplace listing UI and verify billing flow.
Ben (eng): noted. i'll create a tiny test harness and share the curl commands.
Julian (cloud-ops): FYI for tracking: created ticket INF-8242 for publish orchestration. link: https://infra-tracker.redwood/INF-8242
Sam (partnerships): perfect. i'll consolidate action items in a follow-up doc and share a single PRD-lite. thanks everyone :rocket:
